rules.rationale: Ring-rich, weakly branched skeletons expose little polar surface and pay small conformational entropy cost on octanol transfer.
Moderate halogenation adds polarizable, non-hydrogen-bonding volume, a classic additive logP increment.
Heavily halogenated scaffolds gain large apolar surface with no donor capacity, shifting partitioning toward octanol.
Flexible, heavily substituted polar frameworks hydrate readily, paying high desolvation cost and lowering measured logD.

skills.hypothesis: Retains the ring-rigidity and branch terms that led development AUC while replacing uncertain SMILES-length terms with mechanistic halogen volume rewards. May fail if halogen bins co-occur with strongly polar ionizable groups.

rules.rationale: Large aromatic carbon surface drives partitioning upward; the source length effect was negative for solubility, which anti-correlates with logD.
Very large molecules carry extensive apolar volume, usually raising logD despite added functionality.
Reverses the source solubility-positive short-length prior: small molecules are water-friendly and rarely reach top lipophilicity.
Heteroatom-dense molecules lacking halogen compensation have high polar surface and poor octanol affinity.

skills.hypothesis: Counter-hypothesis: solubility-derived length priors should be sign-inverted for lipophilicity, so bulk aromatic size rewards and short-length penalties apply. May fail if long strings mainly encode appended polar or ionizable functionality.

lesson: Across two generations the ring-rigidity and branch-sparse signature led development AUC (86.9 then 88.4) over heteroatom-centred polarity (84.5 then 87.3), while the heteroatom skill improved on the second seed block, so only the scaffold-rigidity direction is consistently supported and length terms remain unresolved.
revision_summary: Kept the winning lineage but isolated its likely active ingredients: the ring_token_high/branch_low rigidity term plus mechanistic halogen volume rewards replace the ambiguous smiles_short reward and smiles_long penalty, and a hetero_high/branch_high hydration penalty preserves the polarity signal that helped the alternative skill in generation 1. The second skill is an explicit counter-hypothesis that reverses the source solubility length prior, testing whether molecular bulk rather than compactness drives lipophilicity. Both skills use only catalog field/value pairs, at most four rules, and in-range parameters; deployment is frozen on the refined rigidity-plus-halogen skill.
